name: Ezequiel López-Rubio
title: Full Professor, Dept. of Computer Languages and Computer Science, University of Málaga
bio: Ezequiel López-Rubio is a Full Professor at the University of Málaga. His research interests include graph theory, machine learning, computer vision, and neural network architectures. He is the creator of the IsalGraph and IsalSR frameworks and the principal investigator of the ICAI research group.

name: Mario Pascual González
title: Dept. of Computer Languages and Computer Science, University of Málaga
bio: Mario Pascual González is a PhD student at the University of Málaga working on graph representation learning and the IsalSR framework. His research focuses on canonical string representations for symbolic regression, search space reduction, and integration of graph-theoretic methods with existing SR algorithms.

name: Karl Thurnhofer-Hemsi
title: Dept. of Computer Languages and Computer Science, University of Málaga
bio: Karl Thurnhofer-Hemsi is a researcher at the University of Málaga. His research interests include image processing, deep learning, and molecular graph representations. He is the lead author of IsalChem, which applies instruction string encoding to molecular graphs.
